title: Church
definition: The church is the people of God redeemed by Christ, called out from the world, gathered under His lordship, and sent as witnesses to the Gospel.
summary: The church is not merely a building or organization. It is the body of Christ, the household of God, and the temple of the Holy Spirit.
christFocus: Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her. The church exists to worship Him, proclaim Him, serve one another, and make disciples.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: The church gathers for worship, teaching, fellowship, prayer, and ordinances.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The church scatters in mission and witness.
